title: FOSSIL architecture validation — five-pass sourced refinement
retrieval_prompt: Reconstruct the five-pass validation of the 2026-08-13 FOSSIL architecture review, including what was ratified as provider-independent invariant, what remains candidate-only, and the remote trust-boundary requirement.

source.representation: Locally preserved five-pass validation synthesis with exact primary-source URLs; external web pages were not archived byte-for-byte.

validation_gates: redaction across canonical store, mirrors, projections, exports and caches
empty-machine canonical recovery and semantic rebuild
hostile remote caller and cross-tenant authorization isolation
longitudinal epistemic correctness and query scaling independent of remote corpus scans

backlog_coverage.fossil-core#81: provider-independent durable storage and replaceable local projection architecture
backlog_coverage.fossil-core#87: S3-compatible/R2 durability plus zero-local-state rebuild proof
backlog_coverage.fossil-core#111: semantic commit hardening, exact packsets/promotion, longitudinal epistemic benchmark
backlog_coverage.fossil-core#48: permission/redaction readiness before shared or cloud deployment

unowned_delta: Make the remote trust boundary explicit inside the existing multi-user/cloud security lane: authenticated principal -> server-owned workspace/tenant -> exact packset -> read/write scope -> capability grants -> CorpusService. Do not treat caller-supplied provenance as authorization.
authority_boundary: Proposed research only. R2 remains a candidate implementation; no SaaS API/SDK shape or multi-writer design is accepted by this handoff.
limitations: External primary-source pages were verified live on 2026-08-13 but were not archived as immutable source-byte artifacts in this pass.
Native multi-pack corpus validation remains required before merge.
